name: Rosario Castellanos
shortBio: Mexican existentialist feminist philosopher and writer whose master’s thesis Sobre cultura femenina and indigenist works laid the foundation for modern Mexican feminist philosophy.
centralQuestion: Can women claim full philosophical and cultural agency without mimicking patriarchal "masculine culture" or erasing Indigenous women?

keyWorks.title: Sobre cultura femenina (On Feminine Culture)
keyWorks.description: Pioneering Mexican feminist philosophical thesis interrogating women’s exclusion from cultural creation and existential transcendence.

keyWorks.title: Balún Canán (The Nine Guardians)
keyWorks.description: Examines Ladino-Maya hierarchies, gender subjugation, and land reform in Chiapas.
